So we should call displayCarStatus with option "fuel". Then we can estimate mileage: we know distance ~750 miles. We need to know fuel tank capacity 50 gallons. We need current fuel level. We can call displayCarStatus. Then we can estimate how many miles per gallon. We don't know mpg. We could assume typical mpg maybe 25 mpg. But better to ask for fuel level. So call displayCarStatus.

  - 只剩下約 301 英里的行駛範圍，距離目標還差約 449 英里。
